INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_chunk (id, tenant_id, knowledge_id, document_id, chunk_index, content, title, token_count, vector_id, ref_count, content_hash, retrieval_count, create_by, create_time, create_dept, update_by, update_time, del_flag) VALUES
(#{item.id}, #{item.tenantId}, #{item.knowledgeId}, #{item.documentId}, #{item.chunkIndex}, #{item.content}, #{item.title}, #{item.tokenCount}, #{item.vectorId}, #{item.refCount}, #{item.contentHash}, #{item.retrievalCount}, #{item.createBy}, #{item.createTime}, #{item.createDept}, #{item.updateBy}, #{item.updateTime}, #{item.delFlag})
